email.subject: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) — war-focused clan with POAP culture (2000+ trophies)
email.body:
Hey!

We’re POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG), a war-focused Clash Royale clan that’s also building something with real identity outside the game: POAPs (Proof of Attendance / Proof of Arena Push), tracked milestones, and a clan memory that doesn’t disappear after the season.

Quick snapshot (current):
- Members: 25
- Required trophies: 2000
- Combined trophies: 182,757
- Avg member level: 42.3
- Weekly donations: 1,292
- Clan War trophies: 160

What you’re joining:
- Clan Wars matter here. We push participation and improvement without guilt-tripping anyone for real life.
- Donations are active and visible. If you like a clan that actually shares cards, you’ll fit.
- Builder energy + culture. We track activity with our own systems (and yes, our clan even has “Elixir” helping leaders keep things organized).

Standouts (so you know we’re real people, not a copy-paste clan):
- raquaza (Co-Leader) — 12,274 trophies. Signature: The Log + Royal Delivery. War driver.
- King Levy (Co-Leader) — 11,532 trophies. Signature: Witch + The Log (you’ll see a lot of control + pressure).
- King Thing (Leader) — 10,317 trophies. Signature: Cannon + Royal Ghost. Builder/ops brain behind the clan.
- Chanco (Elder) — 10,858 trophies, 150 donations. Signature: Inferno Dragon + Witch.
- JaxikoLane (Elder) — 188 donations (donation leader). Signature: Dart Goblin + The Log.

Traditions:
- POAPs for seasons + meaningful clan moments.
- Free Pass Royale: our War Champ tradition. It’s rare, competitive, and celebrated.

What we’re looking for:
- 2000+ trophies (minimum)
- People who like Clan Wars and will use war decks when they can
- Donators and good teammates (skill matters, but reliability matters more)

If that sounds like your kind of clan, check us out here: https://poapkings.com

See you in the river race,
POAP KINGS
